response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY films DESC, original_language_id IS NULL, original_language_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive, so films with replacement_cost equal to 20.99 qualify (replacement_cost >= 20.99).

Films with a NULL original_language_id form one group through GROUP BY. Within equal film counts, that NULL group sorts last, and other ties are ordered by language id. Missing values are never averaged in because rental_rate and rental_duration are NOT NULL, and rental_duration is at least 3, so there is no division by zero.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive, so only films with replacement_cost strictly above 20.99 qualify.
